description: This PHP class defines the jjwg_Markers model, extending from jjwg_Markers_sugar, and manages marker location data, configuration, and validation for mapping features in the SuiteCRM module.

classes.name: jjwg_Markers
classes.description: A model class for map markers, handling configuration and location logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the marker object, optionally loading configuration settings.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads map configuration settings using the jjwg_Maps module.

methods.name: define_loc
methods.description: Defines marker location data based on input, with validation and default handling.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if a longitude value is valid (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if a latitude value is valid (-90 to 90).
